# Commits and pushes on centroid

A commit-msg hook (commitlint, installed from the owner's git template) rejects a message that
breaks these rules, so write it right the first time.

## Message

- Subject: `type(scope): text`. `type` is one of `feat fix perf refactor docs chore test build
  ci style revert`. The text starts lower-case and has no trailing full stop.
- Then a blank line, then a body of at least one sentence saying what changed and why.
- Every line, subject included, is at most 100 characters.
- No trailers (`Co-Authored-By`, `Generated with`), no attribution wording, no email addresses
  (not even in the body). One commit has one author.
- Give the body as a second `-m`, then check it:

      git commit -m 'docs(agents): regenerate the managed block' -m 'The store note changed.'
      git log -1 --format=%B

- Do not add `.commitlintrc.cjs` or `.gitlint`: the git template writes them into every
  checkout and they are not part of the repository. Add files by name, never `git add -A`.

## Before you push

    git pull --rebase

Other agents commit to the same repositories. Rebase immediately before the commit and again
before the push if the push is rejected. Never force-push.

## Push to origin

`origin` is on the on-box GitLab (group `cosmoshot`). Push with the hook skipped; the release
pipeline needs no run for documentation commits:

    GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=30' \
      git push --no-verify -o ci.skip origin main

A push to `main` of a repository with semantic-release adds a `chore(release)` commit
afterwards; `git pull --rebase` picks it up.

## Cyberplanetary repositories: push to the Forge too

The twelve `cyberplanetary-*` repositories have a second remote, `forge`. After origin, push
there with the credential helper (never print or paste a credential):

    GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -c credential.helper= \
      -c credential.helper=/cosmoshot/cyberplanetary-forge/forge_git_credential.py \
      -c credential.useHttpPath=true push --no-verify forge main

On HTTP 503 retry after a minute, up to eight times. Never push to a GitHub remote unless the
task says so (`privatelocalchat` and `sonalon` keep one as their publishing remote).

## Finish

Both heads must be level with their remotes (`git status -sb`), and the tree clean apart from
`.commitlintrc.cjs` and `.gitlint`.
